# RFR Real Estate

> RFR Real Estate & Advisory FZ-LLC is a brokerage and advisory firm that works only in Ras Al Khaimah, UAE. The practice concentrates on Al Marjan Island, Mina Al Arab, Al Hamra Village and Downtown RAK. Clients buy, sell, lease and manage homes, including off-plan launches on Al Marjan Island.

The firm is licensed in Ras Al Khaimah (FZ-LLC; licence number on request). It does not publish a street address. Contact is by phone, WhatsApp or email.

Disambiguation: "RFR Real Estate" here means RFR Real Estate & Advisory FZ-LLC of Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates. It is not RFR Holding, the New York real estate company that also appears in searches for "RFR". The official website is www.rfrrealestate.com; websites with similar names are separate organisations. See https://www.rfrrealestate.com/about and https://www.rfrrealestate.com/official-website

Where it works: Ras Al Khaimah is one of the seven emirates of the UAE. Al Marjan Island is a group of four man-made islands off the Al Hamra coast; Al Hamra Village (the Emirate's original master community) and Mina Al Arab (a low-rise lagoon community) are on the coast; Downtown RAK is the city around the corniche. All four are covered by RFR; the firm does not work outside Ras Al Khaimah.

A longer plain-text summary of the firm, areas, listings approach and every guide is at https://www.rfrrealestate.com/llms-full.txt

## Areas

- [Al Marjan Island apartments & property](https://www.rfrrealestate.com/areas/al-marjan-island): Studios from about AED 920K, 1–2 bed branded residences about AED 1.7–3.5M, 1-bed rent about AED 65–90K a year; designated freehold area; links to the seven Al Marjan apartments RFR lists. Four coral-shaped islands and the new resorts. A group of man-made islands off the Al Hamra coast. Most of RAK’s branded residences are being built here, including Address, Nobu, JW Marriott, Nikki Beach and W, and the Wynn resort is due to open in 2027.
- [Mina Al Arab](https://www.rfrrealestate.com/areas/mina-al-arab): Lagoons, mangroves and the quiet side of the coast. A low-rise waterfront community built around lagoons and protected mangroves, anchored by the Anantara and InterContinental resorts. Villas, townhouses and lagoon-front apartments in an established, family-led neighbourhood.
- [Al Hamra Village](https://www.rfrrealestate.com/areas/al-hamra-village): Golf, marina and the deepest rental market in RAK. The Emirate’s original master community: an 18-hole championship golf course, a marina and yacht club, the Waldorf Astoria, a mall and a decade of tenants. Falcon Island, its private villa enclave, sits within it.
- [Downtown RAK](https://www.rfrrealestate.com/areas/downtown-rak): The working city: corniche, hospitals, offices. Al Nakheel, Julphar and the corniche, where the Emirate actually works. Towers and mid-rise apartments with the highest yields and the shortest commutes to RAKEZ, the hospitals and government.

## Common questions and the page that answers them

- Is Ras Al Khaimah a good place to buy property, and is it a good investment? Answer: It can be, for the right buyer. Foreigners can buy freehold in the designated freehold areas, there is no income or capital gains tax on property in the UAE, and property worth AED 2M or more can qualify you for a UAE Golden Visa (subject to ICP rules; official pages differ on 5 vs 10 years). Against that, CBRE (H1 2026) and ValuStrat (Q2 2026) both show price growth slowing during 2026, CBRE expects more than 34,000 residential units to be delivered between 2026 and 2030, and nobody can promise what prices will do once Wynn Al Marjan Island opens (scheduled September 2027). No return is promised; check the freehold status of the exact unit, the developer, the payment plan, the handover date, the service charge and evidence of rental demand. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/guides/is-ras-al-khaimah-a-good-place-to-buy-property
- Can I buy property in Ras Al Khaimah as a foreigner? Answer: Yes, in the designated freehold areas. Ras Al Khaimah Municipality lists them as Al Hamra Village, Mina Al Arab, Al Marjan Island, RAK Central, Julphar Towers, Al Maareedh (plots) and the upcoming Beach District. The buyer pays a registration fee of 2% of the market value, plus AED 200 for plan issuance and AED 200 for the title deed. You do not necessarily need to be in the UAE: RFR runs video viewings for overseas buyers, and a power of attorney can be used at the transfer. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/guides/buying-property-in-ras-al-khaimah
- How do off-plan payment plans work in Ras Al Khaimah? Answer: Off-plan means signing for a home before it is finished. Plans run from 50/50 to 80/20 across the 9 Al Marjan launches in RFR's current book, with entry prices from AED 920K to AED 4.06M and published handover dates from Q4 2026 to Q4 2028. These are starting prices; the floor, view and payment plan change the final figure. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/guides/off-plan-payment-plans-ras-al-khaimah
- Can I get a UAE Golden Visa by buying property in Ras Al Khaimah? Answer: Official sources set the minimum at property worth AED 2 million in total, owned in your name; off-plan counts according to ICP and RAKEZ, and more than one property can be combined. Official sources differ on whether the term is 5 or 10 years. RFR does not issue visas or give immigration advice. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/guides/golden-visa-ras-al-khaimah-property
- Will Wynn Al Marjan Island raise property prices? Answer: Nobody can promise that. The resort is scheduled to open in September 2027, as reported. Published data show values rose year on year in 2026, fastest for Al Marjan Island apartments, but growth slowed during the year, there is no data yet on prices after the resort opens, and more than 34,000 new units are expected across the Emirate by 2030. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/guides/wynn-al-marjan-effect-on-property-prices
- Mina Al Arab, Al Hamra Village or Al Marjan Island: which area suits me? Answer: Mina Al Arab is a low-rise, family-led lagoon and mangrove community (about 5.5–7% gross, indicative). Al Hamra Village is the original master community with golf, a marina and the deepest rental market in RAK (about 7–8.5% gross, indicative), and the closest established community to Al Marjan Island. Al Marjan Island is where most of RAK's branded residences are being built and where Wynn is due to open; developer entry prices in RFR's book run from AED 0.92M to AED 4.06M. Compare all four areas at https://www.rfrrealestate.com/areas/. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/guides/al-marjan-island-vs-al-hamra-village-vs-mina-al-arab (side-by-side comparison), plus https://www.rfrrealestate.com/guides/mina-al-arab, https://www.rfrrealestate.com/guides/al-hamra-village and https://www.rfrrealestate.com/guides/al-marjan-island
- How do the off-plan launches in Ras Al Khaimah compare? Answer: RFR lists 9 off-plan launches, all on Al Marjan Island and each from a different developer. Starting prices run from AED 920,000 (Masa Residence) to AED 4,060,000 (W Hotel & Residences); five of the nine are on a 60/40 plan, and listed handovers run from Q4 2026 (Manta Bay, Masa Residence, Sora Beach Residences) to Q4 2028 (Nikki Beach Residences). Figures as listed on rfrrealestate.com on 16 Nov 2026; confirm with RFR. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/guides/ras-al-khaimah-off-plan-launches-compared
- What do off-plan, handover, SPA, NOC, freehold or gross yield mean? Answer: Plain-English definitions, consistent with how the site uses each term and linked to the page that discusses it, are in the glossary. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/guides/ras-al-khaimah-property-glossary
- Who is RFR Real Estate, which areas does it cover and how do I start? Answer: RFR Real Estate & Advisory FZ-LLC, a licensed brokerage that works only in Ras Al Khaimah (Al Marjan Island, Mina Al Arab, Al Hamra Village, Downtown RAK); not RFR Holding of New York. Call, WhatsApp or email to start; it is free and there is no commitment. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/ (Quick answers) and https://www.rfrrealestate.com/about

## Key facts

- Freehold: foreigners can buy freehold in Ras Al Khaimah's designated freehold areas, which RAK Municipality lists as Al Hamra Village, Mina Al Arab, Al Marjan Island, RAK Central, Julphar Towers, Al Maareedh (plots) and the upcoming Beach District. UAE and GCC nationals can buy anywhere in RAK.
- Registration fee: the buyer pays 2% of the market value (the seller pays a further 2%), plus AED 200 plan issuance and AED 200 title deed issuance. Source: Ras Al Khaimah Municipality, Lands & Properties Sector.
- Golden Visa: official sources (ICP, u.ae, RAKEZ; checked 15 November 2026) set the property route at a total property value of at least AED 2 million, completed or off-plan. They differ on the term: ICP and RAKEZ say 10 years, the u.ae eligibility table says 5 years for real estate investments. Confirm with ICP or the Ras Al Khaimah application channel at the time of application. Details: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/guides/golden-visa-ras-al-khaimah-property
- Wynn Al Marjan Island: scheduled to open in September 2027, according to press coverage of Wynn Resorts' commentary (Gulf News, Khaleej Times). RFR does not predict post-opening price changes.

- Hours: Monday–Friday 9:00–18:00, Saturday 10:00–16:00 (Gulf Standard Time)
